label: 🛡 PSI drift score
description: Population Stability Index — measures how much a column's distribution has drifted between two reference partitions (e.g. baseline vs. current). PSI < 0.1 = stable; 0.1-0.25 = some drift; > 0.25 = significant drift requiring investigation. Splits the column into bins of the BASELINE partition then compares actual rates.

partition.label: Partition column
partition.help: Categorical column with exactly 2 distinct values (e.g. baseline/current).
